params.body:
## Why

Production, 15 September 2026, 15:56: all twenty `ProcessImage` jobs for vehicle 22861 ended in `ui.photo_service_refused` with a `RequestException 400` from the remove.bg POST. The dealer background went along as `bg_image_url`, a URL to **our own site** that remove.bg had to fetch; the site was in maintenance mode, remove.bg got the 503 page and answered 400. Same loopback class as the PDF fix (PR 428).

Meanwhile the photo tab kept saying "Kopie maken…": its poller was a POST and the browser logged `polling:1 Failed to load resource: 419` every five seconds (stale CSRF token after login / a Livewire round trip), so the tab never saw the jobs had finished failing.

## What changed

**remove.bg** (`Photo::old_remove_background`)
- The background is sent as bytes: multipart file part `bg_image_file`, read from the `background_images` disk. remove.bg has no `bg_image_file_b64` (checked against their `swagger.yaml`), so the file part it is. No third party calls back into the site any more.
- `size`, `add_shadow`, `type`, `image_file_b64` unchanged. No background configured, or configured but missing on disk: no `bg_` parameter at all.
- On a 4xx the log now carries remove.bg's own `errors[0].title` next to the status, not only "status code 400".

**Photo poll** (`ownvehicle.index.polling`, `polling.js`)
- The route is a GET: it only reads, so no CSRF token to go stale. A 401/419 stops the poll and shows once "Sessie verlopen, herlaad de pagina." (`ui.notify`), instead of a red console line per tick.
- Each finished photo in the response carries `failed`: the translated reason from `PhotoFailure`, or `null` when it went through.

**Tile and progress line** (`OwnStockService::polling`, `vehicle.js`)
- The fresh tile for a failed photo shows the red "Niet gelukt. De beeldverwerking gaf geen resultaat terug." chip and keeps the retry action (same magic-wand button, also in the ⋯ sheet on a phone).
- The progress line counts failures separately: "3 van 20 kopieën klaar, 17 niet gelukt" (new key `ui.photo_progress_failed`, five locales).

## Tests

- `RemoveBackgroundTest`: multipart wire shape (file part present with the bytes, `bg_image_url` nowhere in the body, other fields identical), missing background file sends nothing, 4xx logs the title and returns `SERVICE_REFUSED`.
- `PhotoProcessingProgressTest`: route methods are `GET, HEAD`, script uses `$.get` and stops on 401/419, JSON contract for a failed photo (`failed` sentence, chip in the view, retry button kept), counting script and templates.
- Filter `Photo|RemoveBg|Removebg|WireShape|ProcessImage|Polling|PhotoProcessingProgress|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression`: OK (168 tests, 1019 assertions). `CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax`: OK.

## Docs

Findings `2026-09-15-removebg-haalde-achtergrond-op-bij-onszelf.md` (ernst nu, opgelost) and `2026-09-15-fotowacht-419-en-mislukking-onzichtbaar.md` (deze week, opgelost); rules R S1-6.4 and R S1-6.32 amended.

## After merge

The twenty photos of vehicle 22861 sit with `processing = 0` and the reason in the cache; "Naar Stocklist kopiëren" / "Achtergrond verwijderen" again makes them, now with the background as bytes.


## Follow-up (CI)

`SmokeTest::paginasMetId()` now visits `ownvehicle.index.polling` (GET is an id-route). Doing so showed a scalar `?ids=0` gave a 500 in `whereIn`; the controller casts `ids` to an array.
params.title: remove.bg gets the background as bytes; the photo poller stops 419ing and shows failures
